figures.first_seen: a bird taking off up to the right: a pointed head at the front, a stepped tail trailing down-left, and something (P and Q) dangling under it
figures.name: a bird in flight, one wing raised
figures.how: I moved Q and P from where they dangled below the body to the top of it, stacked as one wing swept up and back. The head (S1), the body (L1, L2) and the stepped tail (M, S2) stay as dropped.
figures.seen_before: unsure: tangram flying birds are a common type, but I don't know of this exact figure

figures.first_seen: a figure running or kicking to the right, one arm (P) flung back, a foot kicking out at lower right, with a big flag-like triangle where the head should be
figures.name: a runner in mid-stride
figures.how: I moved the large triangle L1 from the top down to under the hips as the back leg, and the loose small triangle S1 up to where L1 was, as a small head facing forward. The arm, body and kicking front leg stay as dropped.
figures.seen_before: unsure: tangram runners are a familiar type, but I don't know of this exact figure

figures.first_seen: a person with a square head and arms flung out, in a wide skirt, dancing
figures.name: a dancer in a wide skirt, arms out
figures.how: Nothing changed. The square head, the narrow neck and waist, the outflung arms and the wide skirt already read as a dancer.
figures.seen_before: unsure: it looks like the usual tangram people in skirts, but I don't know of this exact figure
